# FDG8107

> AVOID overloading equality operators on reference types if the implementation would be significantly slower than that of reference equality.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.13.2 Equality Operators on Reference Types.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: how fast the operator is compared with reference equality is behavior. The extractor keeps the closing sentence of the chapter (the next chapter covers design patterns) in the body; it states no guideline.
